import { type Infer, number, object, string } from "@tskm/core"

export const addressSchema = object({ street: string(), city: string() })
// @tskm-gen Address from addressSchema #a5911cc3
export type Address = {
  street: string;
  city: string;
}
// @tskm-end Address

export const profileSchema = object({ name: string(), address: addressSchema, zip: number() })
// @tskm-gen Profile from profileSchema #7ac016b7
export type Profile = {
  name: string;
  address: {
    street: string;
    city: string;
  };
  zip: number;
}
// @tskm-end Profile
